title: Tool Sources
subtitle: Connect an MCP server or an OpenAPI (REST) API so its tools become available to AI chat, with per-tool risk tiers and approvals.

empty.title: No tool sources yet
empty.body: Add an MCP server or an OpenAPI API to give the assistant read and write access to the systems your team already uses.

form.name: Display name
form.slugHelp: Prefixes every tool from this source, for example hudu__get_asset. Lowercase letters and digits only.
form.endpointHelp: Use HTTPS, or HTTP when private egress is enabled on a self-hosted server. Credentials are sent only to this origin.
form.endpointHelpOpenapi: Every operation is called against this URL, and credentials are sent only to its origin. Server URLs listed inside the document are ignored.
form.specUrlHelp: Where Breeze reads the API description. The credential is sent with this request only when the document is served from the same origin as the API base URL.
form.partnerWideWarning: A partner-wide source exposes everything this credential can reach in {{vendor}} to every organization's AI chat. Use an organization-owned source when the vendor issues per-customer credentials.

auth.keepExisting: Leave blank to keep the stored credential.
auth.required: Enter the credential for the selected authentication method.

detail.deleteConfirm: Its discovered tools stop being offered to AI chat immediately, and its stored credential is destroyed. This cannot be undone.
detail.loadFailed: Could not load this tool source.
detail.skippedBody: These operations were not turned into tools. Breeze skips what it cannot call safely rather than guessing.
detail.serverOriginWarning: The document lists server URLs on other origins. They were ignored — operations are only sent to the API base URL.

skipReasons.unsupported_param_style: Unsupported parameter style or location (cookie, deepObject, …)
skipReasons.unsupported_security_location: Needs a credential in the query string, a cookie, OpenID Connect or mutual TLS
skipReasons.schema_too_large: Generated input schema is larger than 64 KB
skipReasons.name_not_addressable: Name does not fit the 64-character tool-name limit

tools.heading: Discovered tools
tools.empty: No tools discovered yet. Run a discovery to fetch this server's tool list.
tools.name: Tool
tools.enableReadsConfirmMessage: {{count}} tool(s) will become callable by AI chat with no approval required:
tools.enableReadsConfirmEmpty: No tools are eligible — anything left is already enabled, not tier 1, or still needs review.
tools.enableReadsConfirmSkipped: {{count}} additional tool(s) still need review and will not be enabled.

toasts.discoveryNotQueued: Tool source saved, but discovery could not be queued. Try re-discovering tools.
toasts.created: Tool source added. Discovery has been queued.
toasts.saveFailed: Could not save the tool source.
toasts.deleteFailed: Could not delete the tool source.
